Exposure to GraphQL. Understanding of microservices architecture. Experience working on enterprise web or mobile applications. Educational Qualification B.E. / B.Tech in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related disciplines. B.Sc. Computer Science / BCA / MCA / M.Sc. IT. Other relevant qualifications with strong hands-on development experience may also be considered. Experience Requirements 1–5 years of professional experience in Full Stack Development or related software development roles. Hands-on experience in frontend development using React.js and JavaScript/TypeScript. Experience in backend development using one or more technologies such as .NET (C#), Python, or Node.js. Knowledge of relational databases and REST API integration. Experience with React Native or mobile application development will be an added advantage. Exposure to cloud deployment and CI/CD processes is preferred. Required Competencies Strong Programming & Debugging Skills Analytical & Problem-Solving Abilities Frontend & Backend Development API Development & Integration Database Management Team Collaboration Communication Skills Time Management Adaptability & Continuous Learning Preferred Candidate Profile We are looking for a technically capable and enthusiastic Full Stack Developer with 1–5 years of experience who can contribute to the development and maintenance of web and mobile applications. Interested candidates with relevant Full Stack Development experience are encouraged to apply.

title: DevSecOps Full Stack Security Engineer
description: Job ID 73600 Category Enterprise Technology Location Chennai, India Work Type Hybrid The Full Stack DevSecOps Engineer is responsible for designing, engineering, and delivering security products and platforms from concept through production. The role develops end-to-end solutions spanning front-end applications, back-end services, application programming interfaces (APIs), data pipelines, databases, and cloud infrastructure. The engineer will apply AI and machine learning (AI/ML), where appropriate, to create intelligent automation for security use cases such as vulnerability triage, risk scoring, anomaly detection, and self-service security workflows. The role also embeds secure development practices, Zero Trust principles, and DevSecOps controls throughout the software development lifecycle (SDLC). Working closely with security, product delivery, DevSecOps, and platform engineering teams, this individual will translate security needs and product roadmaps into scalable, reliable, and maintainable engineering solutions. Responsibilities Design, build, test, deploy, and maintain full-stack security products, including user interfaces, APIs, web services, data layers, and cloud-based components. Develop clean, secure, well-tested, maintainable code following secure coding principles and software engineering best practices. Participate in solution architecture, design, and code reviews, ensuring Zero Trust principles and DevSecOps controls are incorporated into product design and implementation. Collaborate with security, DevSecOps, product delivery, and platform engineering teams to translate product roadmaps and security requirements into technical deliverables. Design and implement continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines using technologies such as Tekton, GitHub Actions, and Google Cloud Build. Integrate security scanning and other security controls into software development and deployment pipelines. Troubleshoot, debug, and optimize applications to improve performance, scalability, security, reliability, and maintainability. Use AI-assisted development tools to improve engineering productivity and code quality while following organizational security and responsible-use standards. Evaluate and prototype relevant emerging technologies across AI, cloud-native engineering, DevSecOps, and cybersecurity. Develop and maintain technical documentation, including solution designs, API documentation, deployment guidance, and operational runbooks. Apply Agile development practices, including sprint planning, daily stand-ups, backlog refinement, and retrospectives. Demonstrate curiosity and continuous learning by evaluating new tools, frameworks, engineering practices, and opportunities to apply AI to security and software engineering challenges. Required Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Cybersecurity, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education, training, and relevant professional experience . Minimum of 4 years of full-stack software engineering experience , preferably developing cloud-native applications, security products, developer platforms, or DevSecOps solutions. Proficiency in modern front-end technologies such as Angular, React, and TypeScript , with hands-on experience in one or more back-end technologies such as Java/Spring Boot or Python . Experience designing and developing APIs, web services, and data-driven applications. Experience with relational or cloud-based data technologies such as PostgreSQL and Google BigQuery . Hands-on experience with CI/CD and DevOps technologies such as GitHub, GitHub Actions, Tekton, Google Cloud Build, Docker, Artifactory, and Terraform , or comparable technologies. Experience with a major cloud platform. Experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) services such as Cloud Run, Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE), and BigQuery is preferred; relevant experience with Microsoft Azure or Amazon Web Services (AWS) is also applicable. Understanding of secure software development practices, including secure coding, vulnerability management, application security, and integrating security scanning into CI/CD workflows. Familiarity with infrastructure as code (IaC), containerization, and cloud-native application delivery. Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to different audiences and collaborate across security, product, and engineering teams. Preferred Experience developing security products, security automation, or self-service security platforms. Experience applying AI/ML, large language models (LLMs), or AI-enabled APIs to software engineering or cybersecurity use cases. Experience with vulnerability management, vulnerability prioritization, risk scoring, or anomaly detection. Working knowledge of Zero Trust architecture and DevSecOps principles. Experience with Kubernetes or managed Kubernetes platforms such as GKE. Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools and modern software engineering productivity tools. #LI-MF2

company_description:
HCLTech is a global technology company, home to 230,000+ people across 60 countries, delivering industry-leading capabilities centered around digital, engineering, cloud and AI powered by a broad portfolio of technology services and products. We work with clients across all major verticals, providing industry solutions for Financial Services, Manufacturing, Life Sciences and Healthcare, Technology and Services, Telecom and Media, Retail and CPG, and Public Services.

Our purpose is to bring together the best of technology and our people to supercharge progress. We’re supercharging progress for everyone, everywhere – our clients, partners and their stakeholders, our people, communities, and the planet.

Part of the HCL group, HCLTech was listed on the stock exchanges in India at the turn of the millennium in December 1999. Since our inception, we have pioneered several industry mainstays and established leadership positions in all our chosen segments.

As a company, we are deeply focused on accelerating our ESG agenda. We are also creating technology-enabled sustainable solutions with and for our clients and partners. We embed ESG imperatives into every aspect of our business and ensure that the progress we supercharge is responsible, inclusive and beneficial to all our stakeholders in the long term. We have committed to achieving net zero by 2040.

We recognize the impact that a business like ours can deliver in elevating communities globally, and we continue to improve our efforts and take decisive actions that benefit the communities in which we work and live. Through the HCL Foundation, the CSR arm of HCLTech, we have invested more than $130 million in social development efforts serving communities throughout India across education, health, water, sanitation and hygiene, skill development and livelihoods, environment, and disaster risk reduction, response and management.

We’re powered by our people – a global, diverse, multi-generational talent - representing 167 nationalities whose unique spark, perspective and boundless passion drive our culture of proactive value creation and problem-solving.

Consolidated revenues as of 12 months ending September 2026 totaled $14.8 billion. To learn how we can supercharge progress for you, visit hcltech.com.
